The plate looks like a dinner plate of about 26 cm. The food on it is:
- 1 slice of tuna sashimi, about 25 g
- 2 cucumber maki pieces (hosomaki), about 20 g each, so 40 g
- 2 pieces of spicy crab or California-style roll, about 30 g each, so 60 g
- 2 pieces of spicy roll with tobiko or tempura crunch, about 30 g each, so 60 g

That gives roughly 185 g in total.

For energy, sushi rice is about 1.4 kcal/g, so with fillings the rolls come to about 1.5 kcal/g. That is roughly 160 kcal for 6 rolls plus about 30 kcal for the tuna, so the plate comes to about 230 kcal. Spicy mayo adds a little, so I'm rounding up to 240 kcal.
